label: End session
description: End one of the computer's shell sessions: stop the command it runs, if any, and whatever its commands left running in the background (a server started with `&`), and forget its folder and exported variables, so the name starts over in the home folder the next time a command uses it. A session that does not exist is fine: there is nothing to end. The default agent (`__catalog/base_catalog/computer/agent.weft`) ends its own session when it answers; a run that fails or is stopped first leaves the session up until an EndSession on it, or Restart the shell on the computer's card, which ends every session.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: session
inputs.description: The session to end, as RunCommand names it. Left out, the computer's default session.

outputs.name: ended
outputs.description: True when there was such a session to end, false when there was none.
